preview.title: A student-led community at UofK
preview.body: We are students from the University of Khartoum - from different faculties, skill sets, and interests - united by our passion for Google technologies and the wider world of tech.
preview.imageAlt: GDG UofK members during a community meetup

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To spread knowledge of Google technologies - and technology more broadly - throughout the tech community in Sudan and the Arab world.

whatWeDo.title: More than a club
whatWeDo.description: Three things shape everything we do at GDG UofK.

learn.title: Learn
learn.description: Explore courses, workshops, talks, and practical resources built for students.

build.title: Build
build.description: Turn knowledge into real projects through challenges, hackathons, and collaboration.

connect.title: Connect
connect.description: Meet developers, speakers, and people who share your passion for technology.

story.title: From 2021 to today
story.description: A short timeline of how GDG UofK grew from an idea into a community.

founded.title: GDG UofK founded
founded.description: One of the first Google Developer Groups established in Sudan, founded in August 2021.

events.title: Online events hosted
events.description: Workshops, talks, and study jams delivered to students across Sudan and the Arab world.

today.title: Still learning, still building
today.description: Continuing to grow our community, our skills, and the opportunities we create together.
